question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

To treat nightmare disorder, there is a number of medications and therapies.
solution:
The correct answer is** "there is a number".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The error in the sentence is in the part** "there is a number."**<
